clips.title: The story
paras: Iris Lake is a blighted body of water resting in north-central Ashenvale, east of Astranaar. Once pristine, its waters have turned a sickly yellowish-green from demonic corruption seeping down from Felwood, and hostile bog beasts now prowl its shores.

Nestled between Astranaar and the moonwell tended by Shael'dryn, Iris Lake stands as a grim reminder of the wounds inflicted during the Third War. Fel energies drifting south from the tainted heights of Felwood have poisoned the basin, turning its once-clear waters into a foul, sickly yellow-green mire. The corruption has twisted the native plant life and water spirits, raising aggressive bog beasts that lash out at any traveler who wanders near.

Despite the severe pollution choking the lake, sacred remnants of the past still linger along its edges. Rare crystalline stones known as Elune's Tears can sometimes be found resting along the muddy banks. Keepers of elven traditions, such as Shael'dryn, seek these holy stones to aid in purifying tainted moonwells and resisting the spreading demonic blight across Ashenvale.
